purpose: The four-row form proof of Stage-3 S3-6 CELL-1 (owner decisions 83, 99, 101, 106), re-registered under a new run id. SECOND FAILURE, v1 SMOKE RUN ID RETIRED (2026-09-23). Run id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-SMOKE-4-V1 failed twice: its first launch was refused before any contact (the unconditional first-phase route was seeded twice; repaired by commit 40defa33) and its one root-diagnosed recovery attempt then spent 4 contacts and 10.6 s and died at the openJiuwen vertex solver_0_input with "hypothesis state must contain exactly ['candidates', 'sample_id', 'schema', 'semantics']" -- the stage3-deltas candidate-bound route read the sealed Perception state as the canonical four-key document, while a native episode seals the model's own COMPACT structured-output bytes ({"candidates": [...]}). This fragment is that four-row proof, under a NEW run id with a fresh run-cumulative budget. The fix is rails.knowledge_stores._stage3_delta_local_supply, which now reads the candidate state through the compact branch whenever the candidate state phase DECLARES the compact structured-output contract; it is proven offline, before this flight, by analysis.native_episode_dry_run walking this exact composition node by node with zero contacts (tests/unit/test_native_episode_dry_run.py). STRUCTURAL ONLY: no official score is run here and no effectiveness claim is read from it. The twin smoke keeps its own v1 run id (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-SMOKE-4-TWIN-V1, never opened) and stays registered in configs/experiment/slurp-native-stage3-delta-cell-smoke-4-v1.json; it carries the same fix through the shared rails module.
